name: Can I use regular exterior paint or deck stain on a log home?

mainEntity.name: Can I use regular exterior paint or deck stain on a log home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Log home refinishing requires specialized, flexible exterior log stains rather than standard deck stain or conventional exterior house paint. Standard exterior paint creates an impermeable film that traps natural moisture inside the logs, accelerating hidden internal wood rot and causing surface peeling. High-performance log stains are micro-porous, allowing log timbers to breathe and release internal vapor while shedding rain on the surface. They also contain specialized UV inhibitors and flexible polymers that expand and contract with the seasonal movement of heavy timbers without cracking or blistering.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. Standard paint traps interior moisture inside the logs, causing hidden rot. Log homes require breathable, flexible stains designed specifically for heavy timber movement.
